encoder: answerdotai/ModernBERT-large (weights inside model.safetensors under the encoder. prefix, 170 tensors)
model_kind: encoder-only decision model: ModernBERT-large encoder, type embedding, two pre-LN TransformerEncoderLayer head layers, option-marker scorer, act head
checkpoint_dtype: float16 for 205 tensors, float32 for the temperature buffer (verified from the safetensors header); the plan's bf16 statement is wrong

sibling.temperature_by_options: identical to the root checkpoint; per-type temperature differs

limiting_reason: rl_agent_config.json max_len 512 is the sequence budget of the shipped checkpoint; the vendored build_sequence truncates the state to fit it
input_truncation: vendor/rl_common.py build_sequence: options capped at 48 tokens each, the option block squeezed to leave at least 16 head tokens, the question text capped to the head budget (at least 8 tokens), the state truncated on the right to max_len - len(head) - 1 tokens, closing [SEP] kept
sequence_format: [CLS] <type> question: <instructions> [SEP] [MASK] opt0 [MASK] opt1 ... [SEP] <state> [SEP]; token ids cls 50281, sep 50282, pad 50283, mask 50284
batch_contract: one row per question; rows right-padded with pad id 50283; attention_mask 1 real / 0 pad; marker_pos padded with 0 and marker_mask False; the CPU reference pads to the longest row of the call, the device pads to the seq bucket and the row bucket; padding changes fp32 logits by at most about 4e-6 (doc/probe/README.md)
backend_contract: forward(input_ids int64 [B,S], attention_mask int64 [B,S], marker_pos int64 [B,kmax], marker_mask bool [B,kmax], qtype int64 [B] with choice 0 / score 1 / noul 2) -> (logits float32 [B,kmax] with -1e4 where marker_mask is False, act_logits float32 [B,2]); shapes() describes the geometry; implemented by reference/laya_reference.py (CPU fp32) and tt/engine.py LayaEngine (device); the two were compared on the 200-decision gate subset in stage 6 (doc/full_model/README.md)
host_tail: temperature = temperature_by_options[temp_bucket(type, k)] else temperature[type], clamped to [0.5, 5.0] as pip laya 0.3.27 does (plan amendment A6; the Hub rl_agent_api.py uses the raw value, which differs only for choice:11+); p = softmax(logits[:k] / temperature) in float32; confidence = 1 - H(p)/log k; answer_confidence = max p; score = sum(i p_i); noul = p[1]; act_probability = softmax(act_logits)[0]
activation_outliers: fp32 residual stream max abs 1404 after layer 5, 4007 after layer 12, 11696 after layer 14, 33109 after layer 19 (channels 379 and 382); post-norm tensors stay under 24; see doc/probe/README.md section 6

typed_decisions_gate_token_lengths.source: the 200 gate sequences at max_len 512 / head_max_len 192

capacity_evidence: doc/probe/README.md and /home/hous/dev/laya/reference/parity_corpus_index.json (CPU fp32 corpus at 512); device bucket evidence is added by stages 6 and 7
status: stage 6 (full model): device engine with the server contract passes the 200-decision gates with bf8w_hifi3_erf; stage 4 data-parallel 1x4 passes; buckets 1 to 64 x 512 captured by the server at startup; seq buckets 256 and 128 are a stage 7 decision from the served token-length histogram

device_engine.device_outputs: scorer logits over every position (n, L) float32 and the CLS rows (n, 1024) after the two head layers; the marker gather, the -1e4 fill, the features and act_head run on the host in fp32 (tt/engine.py host_tail, equal to vendor/rl_common.py DecisionModel.forward after the gather)
device_engine.pad_rows: rows beyond the request carry the pad id, an all-zero attention row and qtype 0; shapes()['pad_rows_keep_one_token'] is False (the -1e30 masks keep SDPA finite)
device_engine.row_buckets_reported: total rows per call = per-device bucket x devices; LAYA_ROW_BUCKETS is per device
device_engine.mesh: LAYA_MESH_SHAPE=1x4 opens ttnn.MeshShape(1, 4) without a fabric config: weights replicated, per-call inputs sharded on dim 0, outputs concatenated on dim 0 (doc/multichip_decoder/README.md)

device_bucket_evidence.measured_on_device: stage 3 (one chip) buckets 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 x 512 traced; stage 4 (1x4 mesh) per-device buckets 8 and 16 (32 and 64 rows per call); stage 6 gate run at bucket 8x512, B 2 and B 4 end-to-end rows and the alone/B 2/B 4/B 8/B 64 invariance
device_bucket_evidence.precision_policy_passing_stage_6: bf8w_hifi3_erf (bfp8 matmul weights, bf16 activations, HiFi3, erf GELU fused, fp32 scorer output); gates in doc/full_model/README.md
